hit_def.ours: views>=50K (CapCut-joined reels, emojis read from the CapCut draft = ground truth)

hook_emoji_count.evidence: external hooks with 3+ emojis 1/7 hit 1M (14%) vs 63-68% at 0-2 emojis (n=205); ours: the only 3-emoji hook (Christmas X Target 🎅🏻🎄✨) got 5.3K

global.placement: end of the last line, one space before the emoji run (92% of 148 CapCut cards end with an emoji)
global.skin_tone: keep the team default (🎅🏻 light tone appears 5x in CapCut); never pick tone by audience demographics

then_card.evidence: F04 then-cards: 😬 152.9K + 84.4K; 🤕 67.7K + 40.3K(IG); 🤮 64.5K + 30.9K(IG); 👴🤦‍♂️ 70.4K. External hook 🤮 6/9 ≥1M (median 1.4M). 🤢 2.6K (n=1) and 🤕 on F19 'The problem...' 2.7K -> format, not emoji

bridge_card.evidence: every F04 winner's bridge card: MG-01, MG-06, MGS-01, MGS-02 (⏳), MG-04 (⏱️)

payoff_card.evidence: payoff cards of the 6 F04 winners (152.9K, 84.4K, 70.4K, 67.7K, 64.5K, 40.3K IG)

ski_accessory_hook.evidence: BH-01 🤣⛷️ 61.3K, BH-02 😂 61.1K, BH-03 🤣 43.2K (FB). The same emojis on IG copies got 1.1-4.4K, so the platform/distribution decides that gap, not the emoji

wearable_dont_show_hook.evidence: ours: ❄️ in hook 67% hit (n=18, corpus read, medium reliability); external ❄️ hook 4/4 ≥1M (apparel/wearable), 😳 4/7. Posted HJ winners read visually: 'X-MAS gift doesnt exi-🎄' 91K

gift_hook_external.evidence: external hooks: 😭 4/4 ≥1M (median 2.8M), ❤️ 4/5 (2.6M), 💕 4/6 (4.3M); gifts/apparel. Experiment-only for us (no own data)

caption_cta.evidence: external CTA lines: ✨ 6/7 ≥1M, ❤️ 4/5, 🎄 14/20 (decor_light). Ours: caption 👉 14/16 hits, 👉🏻 4/4 but links were added after reels took off (D6 reverse causality), so it's a safe default, not a lever

avoid.🎁_in_hook: external hook 3/8 ≥1M (median 757K) vs base 61%; ours 1/3 (corpus). Keep it for captions
avoid.🎄_as_hook_emoji: ours CapCut-truth 0/4 (4.2K, 3.1K, 457, 5.3K), external hook 15/27 (56%) vs 62% without. Use 🎄 on payoff cards and captions, not as the hook's emoji

reliability_notes: Corpus own hook_text emojis are vision-transcribed and match the CapCut draft on only 6/35 joined reels (😬/🤕 were read as 😩): use CapCut text for own emojis
External hook emojis come from OCR/vision (medium reliability); captions are scraped text (high)
All per-emoji n are small (2-27). Treat 'use' lists as exploit defaults and everything else as experiment slots
